retrieval: Read-only SSH; OpenCV VideoCapture in /home/jkerr/miniconda3/envs/eyeball211/bin/python. First decoded frame from each stream. No remote files changed.
runtime: One recorded still stereo pair; virtual gaze loops continuously. No controls, no video decoder or 3D library. Pauses when hidden/offscreen; reduced-motion preference gives a static view.
calibration: No stereo_calib.json sidecar was found for this older dataset. Uses the existing left.mp4/right.mp4 spherical projections with their baked calibration warp. Does not apply current camera constants. Historical calibration version is not independently verified.

fixed_preview.note: Virtual pinhole projection of the saved maps, not raw-sensor intrinsics.

target_annotations.note: Approximate hand-selected hole centers in fixed preview pixels. Matched vertical coordinate. Disparity estimates depth in baseline-relative units, not measured metric object poses.

display_geometry.note: Schematic front view: camera +X projects to the reader’s left. R/grey appear left; L/yellow appear right. Depth compression and table height are illustrative, not a calibrated observer camera or reconstructed surfaces. Sampling uses unchanged per-eye rays.
display_geometry.reference_table: Plane y+z=15.8 in the 45-degree display camera frame. Height chosen for illustration; not a recovered table measurement.
display_geometry.table_spacing: Illustrative table target X offsets are compressed to 55% about their midpoint. Cylinder sizes are preserved. Connectors link sampled sphere points to the displayed cylinders; original target directions and RGB sampling are unchanged.
display_geometry.sphere_presentation: Original forward hemispheres: camera center + radius * unit(ray), rendered with the same schematic projection as the table. No local half-turn, separate sphere perspective, or rear-surface tint. Restored from the exact pre-experiment source snapshot.

output.sampling: One bilinear sample directly from the saved native-resolution spherical image; no intermediate per-frame projection.

mask: Border-connected near-black panorama padding (max RGB <12), eroded by one pixel. This is an image-derived validity estimate because no original binary coverage mask was saved. Interior dark image content is preserved.
object_sketches: Code-drawn hollow tape cylinders with shaded outer walls, cardboard inner walls, annular top faces, and light contact shadows. Cached in the static diagram background; no meshes or photo cutouts are loaded.
source_thumbnails: 800 × 600 downsampled original raw sensor frames, at left before the spherical projection arrow. No virtual crop footprint is overlaid on raw sensor pixels.
